name: novus-language
description: Full language support for the self-hosting Novus programming language (.nv) and its server rendered components (.nvh) and Markdown pages (.nvmd): syntax highlighting, IntelliSense, diagnostics, navigation, and run/build commands via novusc.
author: ezTxmMC

semanticTokenTypes.description: A modifier word such as private, final, abstract, async, native, get or set

enumDescriptions: `novus-lsp`, the language server written in Novus (needs the `novus-lsp` binary)
The previous TypeScript server that ships with the extension (no longer developed; kept until `novus-lsp` has every feature)
novus.server.implementation.markdownDescription: Which language server the extension starts. Changing it restarts the server.

novus.server.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `novus-lsp` binary. Leave empty to look for `build/novus-lsp` in the workspace and then `novus-lsp` on `PATH`. A relative path is resolved against the workspace folders.

novus.diagnostics.own.description: `novus-lsp` only: report the problems that the server finds itself (syntax and name resolution), without running the compiler.

enumDescriptions: Run `novusc check` when a file is opened and saved
Also run it after a pause in typing
novus.check.mode.markdownDescription: `novus-lsp` only: when the authoritative `novusc check` runs. Its findings are shown next to the server's own diagnostics.

novus.check.novuscPath.markdownDescription: `novus-lsp` only: the `novusc` binary used for `novusc check` and `novusc deps`. Leave empty to use `novus.executablePath`, then `build/novusc` in the workspace, then `PATH`.

novus.check.timeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: `novus-lsp` only: seconds after which a `novusc check` run is abandoned.

novus.pureline.enabled.markdownDescription: `novus-lsp` only: report violations of the Pureline style (`PL-CF-002` no `else`, `PL-FN-001` function length, `PL-STRUCT-001/002` file and folder size, `PL-NAME-001` short names).

novus.pureline.flagPlainElse.markdownDescription: Also flag an `else` that does not follow a terminating branch (`PL-CF-002`).

novus.pureline.functionReviewLines.markdownDescription: Function length above which `PL-FN-001` asks for a review.

novus.pureline.functionMaxLines.markdownDescription: Function length above which `PL-FN-001` asks for a split.

novus.imports.explicit.markdownDescription: `novus-lsp` only: completion adds the `import` line for a package that the file does not import itself, even when another file of the program already loads it.

novus.format.tabSize.markdownDescription: `novus-lsp` only: indentation width of the formatter when the editor does not send one.

novus.format.insertSpaces.markdownDescription: `novus-lsp` only: indent with spaces when the editor does not send the option.

novus.snippets.indent.markdownDescription: `novus-lsp` only: the indentation unit written into snippet bodies.

novus.completion.maxItems.markdownDescription: `novus-lsp` only: the most items one completion answer holds; a longer list is marked incomplete and narrows while you type.

novus.executablePath.markdownDescription: Path to the `novusc` binary used by **Novus: Run Novus File** and **Novus: Build Novus File**. Leave empty to look for `build/novusc` in the workspace and then `novusc` on `PATH`.

novus.diagnostics.enabled.description: Report syntax and semantic problems for Novus files.

novus.diagnostics.undefinedSymbols.description: Warn about identifiers that cannot be resolved to a variable, method, class or module.

novus.diagnostics.unusedVariables.description: Fade out local variables that are never read.

novus.trace.server.description: Trace the communication between VS Code and the Novus language server.

novus.format.namedArgumentSpacing.description: Spacing around '=' in object initializers and annotation arguments when formatting.

novus.format.maxBlankLines.description: Maximum number of consecutive blank lines kept by the formatter.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run copy-std && npm run compile
